'''Amonos''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the [[Battle of Corellia]], Amonos was among the Republic forces that remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to secure the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] refinery region, and was stationed at [[Sentinel Outpost]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Amonos appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Classic Gear Vendor for the Republic faction in the Black Hole Daily Area, which was added in Game Update 1.2: Legacy on [[April 12]], [[2012]].<ref name="TOR" />
